name: ONA Pass
description: B2B Sunday School check-in and secure pickup app for churches. Each child goes home only with the correct adult.
longDescription: ONA Pass is a check-in app for church children's programs. Parents sign their children in to Sunday School, and at the end of the session the child is released only through a secure pickup. It gives teachers a clear list of who is in the room and gives parents confidence about who collects their child.

caseStudy.problem: A church Sunday School must release each child only to the correct adult.
caseStudy.built: ONA Pass is a B2B web app. The customer is the church, not the parent. Parents sign their children in to Sunday School. At the end of the session, a teacher releases each child only through a secure pickup. Teachers see a list of the children in the room.
caseStudy.result: ONA Pass launched on 25 October 2026. Each church pays a monthly fee for each child.
